commits.subject: Add a TokenBucket Durable Object that persists its state
Rate-limit /api with RateLimit headers, failing closed
Run tests and pnpm dev against in-memory TokenBuckets
Serve /levels from the edge cache for 60 seconds

notes: RPC TokenBucket Durable Object (extends DurableObject, persists the bucket in SQLite-backed storage), IETF RateLimit-Policy/RateLimit headers, 429 {error:'rate_limited', retryAfter:1} with Retry-After, fails closed (503) without the binding, and an edge cache for /levels (Cache API keyed by URL, public max-age=60, X-Cache). wrangler.jsonc uses the declarative exports form; --dry-run bundles it. Tests and pnpm dev run real TokenBuckets in-process (vite alias for cloudflare:workers). Commits 1-2 are red (Node can't load cloudflare:workers until commit 3); test/api.test.ts and test/render.test.tsx now pass bindings. Final 24/24, pnpm build passes, no new dependencies.
